shiftLock.slot: 4-speed automatic: shift lock solenoid. The 096/01M automatic does NOT have a DSG-style yellow tab. Manual override: insert key or small screwdriver into the small slot on the PRNDL bezel cover near Park. Push down to release interlock while pressing brake. Manual trans: clutch interlock only.

steps: PREFERRED — WITH POWER: Parking brake on. Key ON. Press brake. Shift floor lever to N.
MANUAL OVERRIDE (dead battery — auto): Insert small flat screwdriver or key tip into override slot on PRNDL bezel (near P position). Push down and hold. Press brake pedal. Move shift lever to N.
MANUAL TRANS: Depress clutch pedal. Move floor shift lever to N. No shift lock.
FWD: Rear wheel-lift acceptable with trans in N. Flatbed preferred.
Battery: under hood, driver side (left).

battery.location: UNDER HOOD, engine compartment. Driver side (left), under plastic cover. Standard top-post battery.

alerts.notes: Golf/Jetta Mk3 (1993-1999, US). Battery under hood. 4-speed auto (096/01M) — override slot on PRNDL bezel. No DSG. Manual: clutch to N. Corrado (1990-1994) same basic procedure.

meta.transmission: 5-speed automatic (09A/5-speed tiptronic) or 6-speed manual (02M/MQ350) or early DSG (6-speed DQ250 on GTI/GLI from 2004+). Floor console shift.
meta.drivetrain: FWD. Golf hatchback, Jetta sedan/wagon, GTI, New Beetle. VR6 and 4Motion AWD available on some. Rabbit sold as Golf Mk5 in US starting 2006.

steps: PREFERRED — WITH POWER: Parking brake on. Key ON. Press brake. Floor shift to N.

steps: PREFERRED — WITH POWER: Parking brake on. Key ON. Press brake. Electronic selector to N.

DEAD BATTERY: Jump under-hood positive terminal (at fuse box cover) and negative (engine block/ground). Use AGM jump pack (single battery models) or dual-battery capable pack (V10 TDI). Once powered, press brake, shift to N electronically.
AWD 4Motion: FLATBED ONLY. Permanent AWD — never wheel-lift tow.

battery.location: UNDER DRIVER'S SEAT — requires removing driver seat for full battery access. Procedure: slide seat back, remove seat rail covers, remove 10mm triple-square floor bolts (4), slide seat forward, tilt seat back to reveal battery compartment. Remote POSITIVE jump terminal: under hood at fuse box cover. Negative: engine block. ALWAYS jump via under-hood terminals — never attempt to move seat while vehicle is dead.

alerts.notes: Touareg 1st Gen (2004-2010). AWD FLATBED ONLY. Battery under DRIVER SEAT — major disassembly. Jump via under-hood positive stud and negative ground. Air suspension on most models — may need stabilization.

Battery: under DRIVER SEAT. Jump via under-hood terminals only.
